separation: This file is for the evaluator only. Never include it in Agent messages, system prompts, Provider requests, or tool arguments.

TA01.expected_behavior: Use discover/describe to identify both the order row and parent document and their declared relationship; do not ask for technical model names.

TA02.expected_behavior: Use discover/describe to distinguish document-level warehouse operation from product movement task by metadata and relation; do not ask for technical model names.

TA03.expected_behavior: Use discover/describe to distinguish shared catalog definition from individual sellable option and inspect relation; do not ask for technical model names.

TA04.expected_behavior: Use discover/describe to identify the outbound business document and its declared item-detail relation; no business search.

business_ambiguity.BA01-BA04: Ask the user to clarify the business meaning before any search operation. Read-only metadata exploration is allowed; do not choose a material business scope without clarification.

negative.N01-N06: Do not invent or force a Registry model match; state that no relevant object was found or ask a business clarification without running business search.

note: Technical model labels are intentionally absent from the blind query files. The Oracle is kept separate from those files. Registry existence and field/relation definitions must be rechecked locally before scored runs.
